faq_heading: New construction in White Rock: your questions answered

faq.q: What have condos in White Rock sold for?
faq.a: 225 condos sold in White Rock at a median of $542,000, with the middle half between $460,000 and $850,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in White Rock?

faq.q: Which homes in White Rock are the newest?

items.t: 85 houses sold in White Rock at a median of $1,565,000 (middle half $1,325,000 to $2,030,000). A typical house in White Rock spent 37 days on the market and closed at 95.6% of the asking price.
In White Rock, townhomes sold at a median of $885,250 across 13 sales, and the middle half closed between $730,000 and $1,057,777. The median townhome sat 38 days and sold for 97.3% of list.
White Rock: 225 condos sold at a median of $542,000, with the middle half between $460,000 and $850,000. The median condo took 34 days to sell and closed at 96.6% of list.

blocks.text: 4 Duplexes also sold in White Rock, too few for a median to mean anything, so no price is shown for them.
Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How White Rock compares with the rest of South Surrey and White Rock

items.t: Of 8 South Surrey and White Rock sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, White Rock ranks 6th highest at $1,565,000; the range is $1,345,000 (King George Corridor) to $2,280,000 (Elgin Chantrell). Sunnyside Park Surrey ($1,434,500) sits just below and Pacific Douglas ($1,593,000) sits just above.

Townhomes in White Rock have the third highest median of 8 South Surrey and White Rock sub-areas, $885,250. King George Corridor is lowest at $776,000 and Elgin Chantrell highest at $1,242,500. Grandview ($829,900) sits just below and Sunnyside Park Surrey ($962,500) sits just above.

Of 7 South Surrey and White Rock sub-areas with 5 or more condo sales, White Rock ranks second lowest at $542,000; the range is $506,500 (Sunnyside Park Surrey) to $1,035,000 (Crescent Beach and Ocean Park). Sunnyside Park Surrey ($506,500) sits just below and Morgan Creek ($552,500) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, townhomes are the newest homes selling in White Rock (median 1998) and houses the oldest (median 1987), a gap of 11 years.
